text_markup: A "when scored" ability is any ability on an agenda that could meet its trigger condition as a result of the Corp choosing the option to score that agenda during a paid ability window (see {ref:rule_paid_ability_window_corp_score}).
text_plain: A "when scored" ability is any ability on an agenda that could meet its trigger condition as a result of the Corp choosing the option to score that agenda during a paid ability window (see rule 9.2.7d).
